career_ladder.note: Field revenue officials recruited under OSSSC Combined Recruitment Examination enter either as Amin (Level 3), Assistant Revenue Inspector (Level 4), or Revenue Inspector (Level 9) under the Revenue & Disaster Management Department, Government of Odisha. Promotion follows the Odisha District Revenue Service Rules and Odisha Revenue Service Group B Recruitment Rules based on seniority, departmental examination clearance, and merit.

exam_scheme.note: The Combined Recruitment Examination (CRE) for Revenue Inspector (RI), Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI), Amin, Collection Assistant, and Statistical Field Surveyor is conducted by OSSSC in multiple stages: a Preliminary Screening Examination, followed by a Main Written Examination, a Practical Skill Test in Basic Computer Skills (qualifying), and Document Verification.

stages.stage_name: Stage I: Preliminary Examination (Screening MCQ Test)
stages.source_label: OSSSC CRE Scheme of Examination and Syllabus Notification

papers.paper_name: Preliminary Written Examination (General Studies 30 Q, Arithmetic 30 Q, Logical Reasoning & Mental Ability 20 Q, English & Odia Language 20 Q)
papers.negative_marking: 0.33 marks deducted per incorrect answer (1/3rd penalty)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Screening cut-off to shortlist candidates for Main Examination (approximately 5 to 6 times total vacancies)

stages.stage_name: Stage II: Main Examination (Objective Test for Merit Ranking)

papers.paper_name: Main Written Test (General Studies 50 Q / 50 marks, Arithmetic 40 Q / 40 marks, English 30 Q / 30 marks, Odia 30 Q / 30 marks, Computer Knowledge 30 Q / 30 marks)

stages.stage_name: Stage III: Practical Skill Test in Basic Computer Skills
stages.source_label: OSSSC Computer Practical Skill Test Guidelines

papers.paper_name: Basic Computer Skill Test (MS Windows, MS Office - Word, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Access, and Internet Operations)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% qualifying threshold (minimum 20 out of 50 marks required)

stages.stage_name: Stage IV: Document Verification (DV) & Cadre Counseling

papers.paper_name: Scrutiny of Original Educational, Caste, Odia Standard, and Computer Certificates with District Cadre Preference Allocation
papers.qualifying_threshold: Production and validation of all requisite original certificates and Odia language qualification

financial_package.note: Salaries for posts recruited under the OSSSC Combined Recruitment Examination are governed by the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017. Pay levels vary by cadre: Revenue Inspector (RI) enters at Pay Matrix Level 9 (Scale ₹35,400 - ₹1,12,400 with entry basic pay of ₹35,400); Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI) enters at Level 4 (Scale ₹19,900 - ₹63,200 with entry basic pay of ₹19,900); and Amin enters at Level 3 (Scale ₹16,600 - ₹52,400 with entry basic pay of ₹16,600). The package below represents the flagship Revenue Inspector (RI) cadre.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017, Finance Department, Government of Odisha
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated for Revenue Inspector (RI) at entry Level 9 basic pay ₹35,400 + 58% DA (₹20,532) + Odisha HRA (9% to 18% based on posting in rural/sub-divisional headquarters vs Bhubaneswar/Cuttack municipal areas) + medical allowance (₹500) and special field allowance. For junior posts, entry gross is ~₹34,000 for ARI (Level 4, basic ₹19,900) and ~₹28,500 for Amin (Level 3, basic ₹16,600). Deductions include 10% NPS (Basic + DA = ₹5,593 for RI), Professional Tax (₹200), and Group Insurance (GIS).
official_perks: Government residential quarters accommodation or House Rent Allowance (HRA at 9% to 18% based on city tier)
Fixed travel allowance / conveyance support for revenue circle inspections and field demarcation duties
Comprehensive medical treatment reimbursement under Odisha Government Servants' Medical Attendance Rules
Dearness Allowance (DA) indexed to bi-annual revisions by the Government of Odisha
Contributory pension coverage under New Pension Scheme (NPS) with 14% state government matching contribution
Standard statutory leave entitlements (Earned Leave, Casual Leave, Half Pay Leave, and Maternity/Paternity Leave) under Odisha Service Code
